source_scope_notes: Four original SWORD modules with indexed New Testament commentary, the OT-only Keil & Delitzsch original module explicitly unavailable, and HelloAO John Gill original verse anchors.
Original SWORD/HelloAO verse gaps and pooled source records are preserved, not silently repaired.
Original book introductions, chapter headings and source-title explicit passage headings are separated into P.
Book-specific or group introductory source text is preserved with exact original source spans and hashes.
Unindexed original records and chapter-only headings never masquerade as verse-specific exposition.
No modern Bible text, CGBC player changes, or edits to previously accepted books.
Keil & Delitzsch original module has an empty NT text/index: all New Testament content is explicitly unavailable, not synthesized.
